rfp_exhibit_a_cdrl_and_pws_text.description: Primary solicitation or contract input text for DoD CDRL (DD Form 1423) & Data Item Description (DID) Schedule Extractor API.
rfp_exhibit_a_cdrl_and_pws_text.example: EXHIBIT A — CONTRACT DATA REQUIREMENTS LIST (DD FORM 1423-1): CDRL A001: Program Management Plan (PMP), Authority: DI-MGMT-80004A, PWS Para 3.1, Freq: ONE/R, First Sub: 30 DAC, Dist: Statement D, Block 18: NSP. CDRL A002: Monthly Contract Status Report (MSR), Authority: DI-MGMT-80368A, PWS Para 3.2, Freq: MTHLY, Sub: 10th business day, Inspection/Acceptance: DD (Destination/Destination). CDRL A003: Software Product Specification (SPS) & Source Code Baseline, Authority: DI-IPSC-81441A, PWS Para 4.4, Freq: ASREQ/R, Sub: 15 days prior to FCA/PCA. CDRL A004: System Security Plan (SSP) & RMF Continuous Monitoring Package, Authority: DI-MGMT-82001, PWS Para 5.1, Freq: QTRLY, Sub: 45 DAC.
